name_en: Theorem 12.8 (Chapter 12), imported as the V_n case of Theorem 15.5
name_zh: 定理12.8(第12章),作为定理15.5在 V_n 中的特例被引入
statement: What 15.07 needs from this external theorem is its PROOF, not merely its statement: Apostol writes no argument of his own for Theorem 15.5. He states that when V = V_n Theorem 15.5 reduces to Theorem 12.8, then certifies that the imported proof uses only the linear-space property of V_n, and declares it valid for any linear space V. Chapter 15 neither restates nor reproves Theorem 12.8.

anchors.quote: When $V = V_{n}$ , Theorem 15.5 reduces to Theorem 12.8.
Therefore the proof given for Theorem 12.8 is valid for any linear space $V$ .

origin_note: 本节点的内容边界只来自第15章15.07的引用语。我们手上没有第12章原文,故此处不替 Apostol 陈述定理12.8 的完整内容;只记录第15章在此处需要它的哪一部分(整个证明)以及第15章未重证这一事实。

name_en: Part (b) of Theorem 12.10 (Chapter 12), imported as the proof of Theorem 15.7(a)
name_zh: 定理12.10 的 (b) 部分(第12章),作为定理15.7(a) 的证明被引入
statement: 15.08 needs the PROOF of this external part and nothing else: the proof of Theorem 15.7(a), that any independent set in V is a subset of some basis for V, is declared identical to that of part (b) of Theorem 12.10. Chapter 15 supplies no argument for 15.7(a); the citation is the entire proof. Chapter 15 does not restate what part (b) of Theorem 12.10 says.

anchors.quote: The proof of (a) is identical to that of part (b) of Theorem 12.10.

origin_note: 内容边界只来自第15章15.08的引用语。第12章原文不在手上,故不陈述定理12.10(b) 的原始内容;此处只记录第15章向它索取的东西是 15.7(a) 的全部证明。

name_en: Part (c) of Theorem 12.10 (Chapter 12), imported as the proof of Theorem 15.7(b)
name_zh: 定理12.10 的 (c) 部分(第12章),作为定理15.7(b) 的证明被引入
statement: 15.08 needs the PROOF of this external part and nothing else: the proof of Theorem 15.7(b), that any set of n independent elements is a basis for V, is declared identical to that of part (c) of Theorem 12.10. Chapter 15 supplies no argument for 15.7(b). Chapter 15 does not restate what part (c) of Theorem 12.10 says.

anchors.quote: The proof of (b) is identical to that of part (c) of Theorem 12.10.

origin_note: 内容边界只来自第15章15.08的引用语。第12章原文不在手上,故不陈述定理12.10(c) 的原始内容。第15章只说 (b) 的证明与它相同,并未说 12.10 共有几部分或其余部分讲什么。

name_en: Theorem 12.3 (Chapter 12), the V_n Cauchy-Schwarz result whose proof Theorem 15.8 reuses
name_zh: 定理12.3(第12章),定理15.8 复用其证明的 V_n 情形结果
statement: 15.10 needs the PROOF of this external result. Apostol calls it the corresponding result for vectors in V_n and reuses the very same proof for any real Euclidean space, on the stated ground that the original proof consumed only the dot-product properties listed in Theorem 12.2 and not the component definition. Chapter 15 writes no proof of Theorem 15.8 in the real case; it adds only the extra step carrying the argument into a complex Euclidean space.

anchors.quote: When we proved the corresponding result for vectors in $V_{n}$ (Theorem 12.3), we were careful to point out that
Therefore, the very same proof is valid in any real Euclidean space.

origin_note: 内容边界只来自第15章15.10的引用语。第12章原文不在手上,故不陈述定理12.3 的原始表述;此处只记录第15章向它索取整个实情形证明,并自行补上复情形的一步。

name_en: Theorem 12.2 (Chapter 12), the list of dot-product properties the imported proof consumes
name_zh: 定理12.2(第12章),被引入的证明所消耗的点积性质清单
statement: 15.10 needs this external result only as the premise set of the proof it imports: Apostol's ground for transplanting the Theorem 12.3 proof is that the proof was a consequence of the properties of the dot product listed in Theorem 12.2 and did not depend on the particular definition used to deduce these properties. Chapter 15 does not cite these properties as established facts; it instead re-declares properties of this kind as the inner-product axioms of 15.10.

anchors.quote: the proof was a consequence of the properties of the dot product listed in Theorem 12.2 and did not depend on the particular definition used to deduce these properties

origin_note: 内容边界只来自第15章15.10的引用语。第12章原文不在手上:第15章只说定理12.2 列出了点积的若干性质,并未逐条列出它们,故本节点不枚举这些性质,也不断言它们与15.10 的四条内积公理逐条对应。

name_en: V_n as a vector space already constructed before Chapter 15
name_zh: V_n:第15章之前已建成的向量空间
statement: What Chapter 15 imports here is an object, not a proof. 15.03 introduces V_n already labelled the vector space of all n-tuples, with its operations given only as the usual way in terms of components, and 15.06 names Chapter 12 as where V_n was studied. Chapter 15 never constructs V_n, never states its operations explicitly, and never verifies its axioms; verification of the 15.03 examples is handed to the reader. V_n is then used throughout as the standard instance and the source of intuition.

anchors.quote: the vector space of all n-tuples of real numbers, with addition and multiplication by scalars defined in the usual way in terms of components
These ideas were encountered in Chapter 12 in our study of the vector space $V_{n}$ . Now we extend them to general linear spaces.

origin_note: 内容边界只来自第15章的引用语。第12章原文不在手上,故不陈述第12章如何构造 V_n。本节点只记录第15章把 V_n 当既有对象引入这一事实,以及第15章自己未做构造与公理验证。注意:15.03 例3 在 ch15 一侧另有 L1 节点 apostol:v-n-space;本节点记录的是该对象的外部来源身份,不重复表达例3本身,若审计认为二者重合可判 KILL。

name_en: The Chapter 12 definition of dependence and independence for finite sets in V_n
name_zh: 第12章中 V_n 内有限集的相依与独立定义
statement: Chapter 15 does not import this definition; it replaces it and then asserts compatibility. 15.06 announces that dependence, independence, bases and dimension were encountered in Chapter 12 for V_n and are now being extended, and 15.07 gives a fresh definition and claims that on finite sets it agrees with the Chapter 12 one, the new definition being unrestricted as to finiteness. The agreement is asserted, not verified anywhere in Chapter 15.

anchors.quote: If S is a finite set, the foregoing definition agrees with that given in Chapter 12 for the space $V_{n}$ .
These ideas were encountered in Chapter 12 in our study of the vector space $V_{n}$ . Now we extend them to general linear spaces.

origin_note: 内容边界只来自第15章15.06/15.07的引用语。第12章原文不在手上,故不写出第12章的定义原文,也不核对两定义是否真的在有限集上一致 —— 第15章只是断言一致。

name_en: The complex vector space V_n(C) of Section 12.16
name_zh: 12.16 节中的复向量空间 V_n(C)
statement: An example imported by name only. 15.10, having defined complex Euclidean space, offers V_n(C) as one instance and locates it in Section 12.16 as something discussed briefly there. Chapter 15 neither constructs V_n(C) nor exhibits an inner product on it nor verifies the complex inner-product axioms for it; the example carries no proof load in Chapter 15.

anchors.quote: One example is complex vector space $V_{n}(\mathbf{C})$ discussed briefly in Section 12.16.

origin_note: 内容边界只来自第15章15.10的引用语。12.16 节原文不在手上,故不陈述该节对 V_n(C) 讲了什么;第15章自己也只说 discussed briefly。

name_en: The Volume II proof of the closed form for the orthogonalized powers
name_zh: 第II卷中对正交化幂序列闭式的证明
statement: A forward outsourcing rather than a back-reference. Having produced y_0 through y_5 by Gram-Schmidt, 15.13 asserts a closed form for y_n as a constant times the n-th derivative of (t^2 - 1)^n and defers the proof to Volume II. Chapter 15 nevertheless uses that closed form immediately, defining the Legendre polynomials P_n by the same derivative expression, so an unproved identity is load-bearing for a definition in this chapter.
aliases: Rodrigues-type formula deferred to Volume II

anchors.quote: We shall encounter these polynomials again in Volume II in our further study of differential equations, and we shall prove that

origin_note: 内容边界只来自第15章15.13的引用语。第II卷不在手上,故不陈述那里的证明如何进行;此处只记录第15章把该等式的证明推给了第II卷,而自己已经在用它。

name_en: The uncited fact that a second-order homogeneous linear equation has a two-dimensional solution space
name_zh: 未标注出处的事实:二阶齐次线性方程的解空间是二维的
statement: A borrowing with no citation attached. 15.08 Example 3 asserts that the solution space of y'' - 2y' - 3y = 0 has dimension 2, with basis e^{-x} and e^{3x}, and that every solution is a combination of these two. Chapter 15 proves none of this: it verifies neither that the two functions span the solution set nor that no third independent solution exists, and it names no chapter, section or theorem as the source. The independence of the two exponentials is available inside Chapter 15 (15.07 Example 7), but the spanning half is not.

anchors.quote: EXAMPLE 3. The space of solutions of the differential equation $y'' - 2y' - 3y = 0$ has dimension 2.
One basis consists of the two functions $u_1(x) = e^{-x}$ , $u_2(x) = e^{3x}$ .

origin_note: 锚点是第15章的断言处,不是引用语 —— 第15章在此处没有引用语,它没有指向任何外部出处。把该事实判为外部的是我们的推断(第15章内确实没有证明它),不是第15章的说法。因此本节点标 origin: model,并且刻意不指名任何第12章或第8章的定理编号:我们无原文可查,指名即为编造归属。

name_en: The uncited fact that the n unit coordinate vectors form a basis of V_n
name_zh: 未标注出处的事实:n 个单位坐标向量构成 V_n 的基
statement: A borrowing with no citation attached. 15.08 Example 1 asserts that V_n has dimension n and that one basis is the set of n unit coordinate vectors. Chapter 15 verifies neither the independence nor the spanning of that set, and names no source. This is the only place where Chapter 15's abstract notion of dimension is tied to a concrete number, and the tie rests on credit taken from outside the chapter.

anchors.quote: EXAMPLE 1. The space $V_{n}$ has dimension $n$ . One basis is the set of $n$ unit coordinate vectors.

origin_note: 锚点是第15章的断言处,不是引用语 —— 第15章在此处未给任何出处。判其为外部借用是我们的推断(第15章内无证明),并且我们不指名第12章的任何定理编号:无原文可查,指名即为编造归属。
